# velora-printer

Deepin Print Manager is a eazy tool to manage printers.

- Repository: <https://github.com/LingmoOS/velora-printer>
- License: `GPL-3.0-or-later`
- One-line summary source: `debian/control` (`Description` of `Package: dde-printer`)

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 14 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `debhelper-compat (= 11)`
- `qtbase5-dev`
- `qttools5-dev-tools`
- `libdtkcore-dev`
- `libdtkwidget-dev`
- `libdtkgui-dev`
- `pkg-config`
- `g++ (>= 8.3.0)`
